end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi made two attempts; neither was unaided correct.
They sometimes counted the bundle as one when finding the total.
They later stated that one bundle and three sticks makes thirteen, with counting on from ten.
Lesson ended when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making numbers with one bundle of ten and some loose sticks. Saanvi used counting on from ten to say that one bundle and three sticks is thirteen. They also mixed up the bundle as one item when finding the total; this was still seen at the end. At home, practise with one group of ten objects and 1–5 separate objects, asking, “How many altogether?”
